title: Social and Commercial Entrepreneurship
modules: CLO1: Aspects and challenges of a new venture
CLO3: Steps in creating an enterprise
evaluation: Final Exam 40% (CLO3, CLO4; technical notes and illustrations from class)

sessions.topic: Entrepreneurship: social, commercial and hybrid organizations
Challenges of an entrepreneur and a new start-up; women entrepreneurs
Traits and qualities of successful entrepreneurs
Creativity and innovation; generating new product and business ideas
Fundamentals and application of business models; business model canvas
Product development as a solution to a customer or societal need; product-market fit
Sole proprietorship, partnership, LLP, private and public limited, cooperative, society, trust, Section 8 company
Sources of finance for a start-up: seed capital, angel investors, crowdfunding
Principles and guidelines for developing and delivering a start-up pitch
Fundamentals of e-business; environment of e-commerce
Designing and leading an entrepreneurial venture; team building; growth
Digital marketing and analytics; AIDA model and the sales funnel
The MBA Entrepreneurship Model and list of business ideas

note: The syllabus lists themes without session numbers. The final exam covers CLO3 and CLO4 (process, financing, pitching, business plan, e-business, leading, ethics), and almost none of that has a deck in the folders.
